太平年
programme.desc: 太平年是一部2026年中國播出的歷史題材電視劇，該劇不以愛情線為主軸，但卻衝出了高收視高口碑！劇本紮實，拍攝水準好，許多場面都拍出磅礡大氣太平年由楊磊擔任總導演，董哲編劇，白宇周雨彤朱亞文俞灝明董勇倪大紅朱嘉琦等主演該劇以五代十國末期至北宋初年為時代背景，聚焦於吳越國納土歸宋的歷史事件，講述了吳越國王錢弘俶周世宗柴榮宋太祖趙匡胤宋太宗趙匡義等歷史人物擺脫戰火國殤，在亂世中尋求國家統一故事ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt五代十國時期，錢弘俶（白宇 飾）趙匡胤（朱亞文 飾）郭榮（俞灝明 飾）三位有志青年經歷了家國動亂秩序崩潰生靈塗炭後，逐漸認識到只有國家一統才能擺脫戰火國殤錢弘俶於政權動亂之時扛起吳越國主的重任，保境安民，福澤一方；歷經戰亂的趙匡胤則延續了郭榮未竟的事業，建立北宋政權，嚴明軍紀，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一掃五代喪亂之頹風，向著天下太平一步步邁進最終，在北宋統一的大勢和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吳越王錢弘俶封疆獻土，納土歸宋，完成了中國歷史上一次偉大的統一本劇表達了中華民族自古以來對和平的熱切追求對統一大勢眾望所歸和對安定生活的真誠嚮往

programme.title: 乘風踏浪
programme.desc: 乘風踏浪由喬杉楊子姍領銜主演的時代創業喜劇該劇講述了以彭錦西和羅虹夫婦為代表的興城泳裝人乘著改革東風成功創業的故事，通過兩個小人物從解決溫飽到成為萬元戶，再到成為當地企業家代表的歷程，將時代發展浪潮的關鍵節點一一還原，以小見大地展現出改革開放的變遷史ampampampltbrampampampgt1978年，20歲的遼寧興城人彭錦西（喬杉飾）被情敵秦升舉報投機倒把入獄，失去了上大學的資格彭錦西出獄後自產自銷做起泳褲生意，女友羅虹（楊子姍飾）不離不棄，他們克服重重困難喜結連理，彭錦西成為當地第一個萬元戶1980年代初，政策放開，遠親賈為民等人效仿彭錦西建作坊做泳裝，開始與他展開價格戰，彭錦西夫婦見招拆招，既鞏固了本地市場，又團結了同行，讓興城泳裝走向全國1990年代，彭錦西遭遇秦升復仇和市場整改的雙面夾擊，跌入低谷，他依舊樂觀，憑藉過人的智慧，幾經沉浮找到突破口，建立正規工廠和自主品牌，成功突圍之後，夫婦二帶領興城泳裝乘風踏浪，成為全球最大的泳裝生產基地

programme.title: 孺子可教也
programme.desc: 在迎來小學畢業試之際，三位教育方式截然不同的鷹爸，兔爸以及羊爸，以自認為最好的教育方式管教孩子，卻忽略了孩子的天賦差異和需求，造成與孩子的感情出現裂痕爸爸們痛定思痛後，決心撕下ampampampquot動物屬性ampampampquot的標籤，努力修復好親子關係，陪同孩子一起面對畢業試這個重要的里程碑

programme.desc: 俗話說：歹路不可走歹事不能做毒品不可食為什麼有人敢逆天逆地，犯下滔天大罪？枉死的冤魂 ，誰能替他們討回公道？三百年前的神祕事件，從台灣頭到台灣尾的精彩故事，盡在台灣傳奇

programme.title: 大漢天子III
programme.desc: 雄主登巔野心不減 帝國極盛暗藏風雲步入中年的漢武帝，稱帝二十餘年，驅伊稚部落於漠北，削諸藩而一統，富國強兵，使大漢王朝進入了輝煌鼎盛時期 永不滿足的漢武帝，不斷設計自己的人生藍圖他聯合西域，穩定北疆，再無後顧之憂；又將目光轉向南越，意在建成最強大的大漢王朝在一批股肱之臣紛紛下世後，武帝大膽起用漢室新一代棟樑，他們抱著新的理想，摩拳擦掌欲展開年輕一代的故事同時，武帝痛感到光陰催人，理想遠大而天不永年，對長生不老的追求也越來越急迫

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.title: 綁架者
programme.desc: 一起車禍意外，牽扯出一樁重案組警員林薇（白百何飾）女兒的綁架案，唯一的嫌疑人楊念（黃立行飾）因頭部受到撞擊喪失記憶，面對林薇的步步緊逼與不斷襲來的殺機，陷入迷局的楊念決定挽回自己的記憶隨著楊念重返綁架兒童販賣器官的組織逐漸想起的破碎記憶，他驚覺這一切，竟與追查此案的重案組組長陸然明道飾有著密不可分的關係，而整個警界更有著不可告人的黑暗面而尚未失去記憶前的自己，真實身分又是誰？

programme.title: 少林寺之得寶傳奇
programme.desc: 客棧老闆西門得寶為了招攬生意，吩咐小弟假扮劫匪打劫路人，自己則假扮將軍出手相助，然後引導客人進店消費後來，靈州刺史為了奪取藏在客棧的藏寶圖，殺害欽差，並嫁禍於得寶得寶成了通緝要犯妻離子散，陷入絕境的得寶被一個神秘僧人搭救為了復仇，得寶開始跟隨僧人修煉武功，而一場陰謀也慢慢被揭開

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龍星買了一個縣令官職，他愛上的美女秦氏卻嫁給一位富商數月後，戚秦氏因絕世美貌遭水師提督常昆之子常威染指，戚家當晚慘遭滅門，首要凶嫌戚秦氏被刑求入獄待秋後處斬包龍星則被迫拔官，淪落至一妓院做龜公，因緣際會結識微服出遊之皇帝，被封為八府巡按後回鄉重審此案，號稱白面包青天，終將常威就地正法，戚秦氏沈冤得雪

programme.title: 急凍行者上
programme.desc: 錦衣衛高手賀英奉皇帝之命前往天竺國曾歃血為盟的兄弟元龍聶虎和薩獒，在賀英歸來途中對他展開突襲，而一陣地動山搖引來巨大雪崩，將四人一併淹沒400年後，被意外解凍的賀英來到了現代社會，但聶虎薩獒元龍三人也相繼從冰封中解凍，他們為了各自的目的不停追捕賀英，四兄弟之間的秘密也相繼揭開

programme.title: 急凍行者下
programme.desc: 明朝將軍賀英阿狗與聶虎來到現在香港，經歷青馬大橋之戰，最終阿狗死去，而賀英與阿虎則被警方扣查從明朝來到現代的副警務署張一鳴帶走賀英與阿狗，藉賀英手上的時空金碟回到明朝，而賀英選擇回到桃源村的道路，卻影響了他與其他相關人等的往後命運

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻偕同十三姨梁寬赴京城與父親黃麒英相敘，並協助開辦寶之林藥廠事宜獅王大會即將舉行，惡霸趙天霸視黃飛鴻為大患，邀黃飛鴻談判時設下重重陷阱欲置黃死地，幸虧黃麒英一干人趕到支援，解除困境趙霸天咄咄逼人，逼使黃飛鴻不能袖手旁觀，決定挺身而出，阻止趙天霸此等敗類奪取獅王美名

programme.title: 焚城
programme.desc: 一場意外引發輻射洩漏，全香港命運危在旦夕為應付這場毀滅性災難，專家范偉立加入緊急危機應變小組，消防隊臨危受命深入輻射區，拼死阻止輻射擴散全港，面對前所未見的末日浩劫，香港會否一夜滅城？

programme.title: 黑俠
programme.desc: 徐夕隸屬專門訓練無痛無感殺手的組織：701部隊，但他不欲成為殺人工具，故隱身香港，從事圖書館文員來掩飾身份徐夕不懂人際，常遭同事白眼，唯獨有兩個人接近他，一個是圖書館女同事Tracy，另一個是棋友辣手神探石Sir當701部隊突然出現，徐夕為友情化身成為黑俠，出手與701部隊對抗

programme.title: 甜蜜殺機
programme.desc: 資深刑警王志毅辦案效率奇差，卻天生有閃避危險任務的神準第六感警察署長的女兒高依萍一心想當警察，擔心愛女安危的署長靈機一動，下令王志毅與她搭檔，兩人水火不容，更被分配到調查可愛小狗死亡這種輕鬆差事沒想到這樁案件竟誤打誤撞，讓兩人追查到了警局通緝要犯的下落，更牽扯出一串驚天動地的謀殺案！

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: 吳家大子吳理（呂方飾）對性感的麥當娜（李麗珍飾）朝思暮想，二女吳采（羅美薇飾）則借故親近表哥強（陳百強飾），小女兒吳姿（關佩琳飾）因小泰龍（柯有倫飾）一次相救而心生傾慕而吳太太（馮寶寶飾）不甘只當家庭主婦，決定參加話劇演員招考，並奇蹟入選劇團女主角，此時，劇團導演（樓南光飾）又對吳太展開追求，讓吳福基醋意大發話劇上映當日，吳家全體竟把話劇台詞當真，引起一陣風波

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中，遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，實則要讓王子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難，成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時刻

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: 羅森（譚詠麟飾）與螃蟹（劉德華飾）是情同手足的職業賭徒應龍哥邀請，兩人赴美國賭城破解了以日本人宮木父子為首的國際老千騙局，並結識了正在賭城度假的香港千金童可人（陳玉蓮飾），羅森更與她相戀三人回香港後，宮木太郎為了報復，雇香港黑幫人士追殺羅森羅森得螃蟹相救逃過一劫，但是螃蟹的左手卻也因此受傷，只好黯然退出江湖

programme.title: 金錢帝國：追虎擒龍
programme.desc: 1973年，香港警察與黑道勾結，貪污巨利，荼毒市民港督終於決定成立廉政公署，由黑白雙煞陳克和白松安組成第一批廉政公署調查員，調查權傾黑白兩道的總華探長徐樂及黑道霸主跛豪，嚴厲打擊香港的地下規則和貪污的大老虎，兩人聯手出擊，出現了打貪成效，但也因徐樂與跛豪決定合作對抗廉政公署，更有不少廉署成員相繼遇害，但陳克不放棄信念，一場正義與邪惡的爭鬥，從此拉開了帷幕

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 賭神

programme.title: 代號：鐵鉻行動
programme.desc: 1950年6月北韓南侵，南韓節節敗退為了扭轉戰局，麥克阿瑟將軍策動鐵鉻行動，秘密派遣KLO部隊滲透北韓偵查情報海軍上尉張學修領軍潛入敵陣，卻遭北韓司令林杰振懷疑，任務即將曝光時間僅剩24小時，攸關朝鮮半島歷史與命運的鐵鉻行動就此展開！

programme.title: 驚天盜數
programme.desc: 維克多是一名小偷，俄羅斯黑幫成員希望他執行一樁搶案，然而維克多對這群新朋友的銀行搶劫計畫並不放心就在眾人準備下手時，國際刑警組織的特工殺死了黑幫成員並逮捕維克多，而負責搶案的司機毒蟲拉沛多卻在維克多的協助下逃走事實上維克多是名臥底警察，但隨著臥底行動終止而被吊銷職位並面臨調查，在心灰意冷之際，維克多決定沿用黑幫計劃，與拉沛多一起搶劫銀行

programme.title: 迫切救援
programme.desc: 在美國與墨西哥相接的邊境四個州之中，德州發生最多起非法移民死亡案件，邊緣城市受到毒品黑幫與人口販賣的威脅也層出不窮一名甫畢業的女孩在畢業晚會回家途中遭到綁架，她的哥哥萊恩必須與時間賽跑，要從專門販賣年輕女孩的人口販子手中救回妹妹，在她被人蛇集團吞噬並消失在這世界之前

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 驚天凍地
programme.desc: 1980年代，脫衣舞孃辛蒂聲稱從殺人魔手中逃出，並向警方求援阿拉斯加州警葛蘭認為辛蒂描述的殺人犯，和近期的連環女子凶殺案高度相關，決定深入調查，並讓處境堪憐的辛蒂借住家中葛蘭鎖定一名衣冠楚楚卻前科累累的嫌疑犯，然而狡猾兇嫌不留絲毫證據，辛蒂更出現各種怪異舉止，葛蘭能否替深埋雪中的被害者查出真兇？

programme.title: 我家有個大腳怪
programme.desc: 寧靜的小鎮希登松樹，大腳怪伯蒂與霍華德吉爾和他們的女兒艾莉住在一起伯蒂像人類一樣被撫養長大，聰明伶俐，運動健將，而且是個頑皮的惡作劇狂然而，伯蒂田園詩般的生活是有代價的希登松樹鎮鎮長意識到，如果自己能發現第一個大腳怪，就能名利雙收，於是便與兒子密謀設陷阱，設下陷阱，揭穿伯蒂的秘密！

programme.title: 超時空救難小英雄
programme.desc: 寒假期間，愛吵架的兩兄弟鼻涕和水花，搭火車前往偏遠小鎮探望他們的奶奶卻在抵達的時候，發現一切都變了樣！兩兄弟展開調查，發現小鎮和居民都面臨危機，於是他們開始追捕一名神秘的偷洞小偷最終，這對年輕英雄不僅拯救了小鎮，還拯救了其他地方事實上，他們拯救了全世界避免被一個巨大的黑洞給吞噬！

programme.title: 反恐行動：獨立日
programme.desc: 12月6日是芬蘭的國慶日：獨立日，但今年顯得特別不平靜，總統官邸遭到恐怖份子襲擊，連總統在內的大批貴賓遭挾持成為人質！安全情報局幹員麥克斯被指派為這場人質危機的談判專家，他必須採取大膽行動，找出幕後真凶不僅人命關天，甚至整個歐洲的未來安危都肩負在麥克斯身上！

programme.title: 安娜
programme.desc: 盧貝松動作驚悚新作，地表最強女殺神誕生！一名謎樣女子，臥底黑白兩道，彈無虛發懲治惡徒，是當今世界上最令人恐懼的政府刺客在引人注目的美麗之下，深埋著極大秘密，眾人只知道她的名字叫：安娜

programme.title: 絕對逆襲
programme.desc: 麥克是懷有滿腔熱血與理想的年輕律師，但西裝筆挺的他私底下卻是個重度癮君子某天發生了一起醫護人員因公意外感染愛滋的案件，因為背後隱藏著政府司法及醫療體制構成的龐大秘辛，竟沒有任何一位律師願意為他們發聲為了正義，麥克毅然決然地挺身而出，遊走於黑暗與光明間的他，也被迫面對自己心中的黑洞

programme.title: 高壓制裁首
programme.desc: 資深警探布萊特和年輕搭檔安東尼因暴力執法影片外流而遭到停職處分，身無分文且亟需用錢的兩人決定鋌而走險，深入地下犯罪世界，卻發現躲在暗處的危險和誘惑，不只威脅他們的生命，也考驗著兩人的道德操守

programme.title: 女戰士
programme.desc: 西元60年，凱爾特戰士布狄卡與丈夫普拉蘇塔古斯共同統治著繁榮進步的愛西尼部落，丈夫去世後，王國無男嗣，羅馬人乘機奪取了她的土地和財產，陷入絕望的布狄卡決心復仇，她成功號召凱爾特與不列顛諸部落，聯手對抗入侵的羅馬帝國，掀起了一場前所未有的史詩戰爭

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 奇楚亞救援
programme.desc: 在後世界末日的時代，一名懷孕的奇楚亞女孩和她的克里奧爾人伴侶，計畫從危險的難民營逃走，為新生命尋找更好的未來這場穿越數千公里的沙漠旅程因為被工業開發破壞而更為艱困，途中遇到一位試圖拯救難民的戰地記者，這場人道救援行動能否成功？

programme.title: 特務殺很大
programme.desc: 一名罹患絕症的特務，接到組織交付的機密任務，該任務可以換取搶救他生命的藥物，但他一直隱瞞家人的特務身份也將被揭穿為了活命，特務不惜在巴黎殺出一條血路

programme.title: 罪惡對決
programme.desc: 1970年代的愛爾蘭，芬巴墨菲在戰爭後隱居偏遠小鎮，為了擺脫過去，芬巴決心重拾對生活的熱情，同時一個愛爾蘭共和軍小組也來到小鎮藏身，當芬巴發現其同夥曾對當地女孩施暴後，便迫使他在金盆洗手前執行最後一次任務，隨著局勢愈加緊張，芬巴必須在暴露自己祕密身分和保護鎮民之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 危機倒數
programme.desc: 美伊戰爭時期，被派至伊拉克擔任拆彈隊長的詹姆斯雖然經驗老到，在一次任務中卻因他的堅持，意外讓隊友們陷入死亡絕境，小隊中開始出現反彈聲浪不久後的一場突襲任務出現一名自殺炸彈客，詹姆斯才意識到，自己的一舉一動將無法逆轉地改變身邊每一個人的命運；命懸一線的隊員，該如何從全世界最危險的戰地平安回家？榮獲奧斯卡最佳影片及最佳導演等六項大獎

programme.title: 再見街貓BOB
programme.desc: 在街頭自彈自唱兼賣The Big Issue大誌雜誌的詹姆士，從他遇見流浪貓Bob的那天起，他們就療癒了彼此，不再讓彼此流浪，並展開一段堅定無比的人貓情誼他帶著Bob上街賣藝，而Bob在賣藝期間，也總是靜靜待在詹姆士的琴袋上吉他上，甚至是肩膀上這次，詹姆士將和Bob度過彼此在街頭的最後一個聖誕節，Bob也將再度幫助詹姆士度過最艱難的時光，並讓他了解到聖誕節精神的真諦

programme.title: 311：東京大震盪
programme.desc: 2011年3月11日，日本遭遇史上最大地震的襲擊，引發福島海嘯災難亞歷珊卓拉剛從法國來到東京，正準備在當地法商銀行工作，卻突然遭逢這場核災危機在工作與家庭間拉扯，逐漸浮現的恐懼與焦慮就要吞噬亞歷珊卓拉離開或者留下，丈夫兒女與仰賴她的員工，亞歷珊卓拉該如何抉擇？

programme.title: 野性獵殺
programme.desc: 特種部隊退役的法蘭克以販賣野生動物為業，某日他在巴西捕獲了一隻兇猛罕見的白色美洲豹沒想到船運過程中，碰上美國國安局正押解危險重刑犯洛夫勒，洛夫勒逃脫國安局的監控，並釋放船上所有的野生動物，法蘭克必須設法活捉美洲豹，還得協助美國政府捉拿洛夫勒，一場船上惡戰即將展開

programme.title: 上海灘
programme.desc: 1930年代的上海，熱血愛國青年許文強因故身陷囹圄，出獄後隻身闖蕩上海，在一次意外中結識了生死之交丁力兩人發誓要在上海黑幫闖出一片天，卻同時捲入了上海大亨馮敬堯的家族鬥爭

programme.title: 江湖女間諜
programme.desc: 來自愛爾蘭的瑪麗亞一號，從小隨著革命家父親為反對英國統治而四處進行破壞一次行動中父親不幸喪命，她誤打誤撞躲藏在馬戲團，遇到法國來的瑪麗亞二號為了幫她逃避英軍追捕，兩個瑪麗亞結成表演組合，因大膽表演迅速爆紅一次表演後，瑪麗亞二號邂逅了革命首腦弗洛雷斯並為其偉大情操打動，但弗洛雷斯卻不幸被獨裁者追捕射殺，瑪麗亞二號便繼承其遺志，號召村民展開抗爭，瑪麗亞一號也憑多年經驗來幫助平民百姓

programme.title: 倩女幽魂3：道道道
programme.desc: 小和尚十方（梁朝偉飾）隨師父白雲（劉洵飾）護送金佛，在蘭若寺遇到女鬼小卓（王祖賢飾）與小蝶（利智飾）十方放走小卓，但白雲卻被復活了的千年樹妖所擒，並逼小卓嫁給黑山老妖十方掘出小卓骸骨逃出蘭若寺，並在劍俠燕赤霞（張學友飾）的幫助下救出師父在鬥法中燕赤霞與高僧白雲合力消滅了千年樹妖，但此時黑山老妖卻欲將其一網打盡十方唯有化成佛祖金身，由小卓帶著飛上天空接太陽純陽之氣，藉以消滅老妖

programme.title: 荒野一匹狼
programme.desc: 南北戰爭結束不久後的美墨邊境小鎮外，一位拖著棺材漫步在泥濘荒野上的浪人姜戈，解救了一名原將被處以火刑的美麗女子瑪麗亞在這目無法紀的鎮上有著二股惡勢力，隨著姜戈偕瑪麗亞重回小鎮，是否將掀起更大的腥風血雨？而姜戈背後拖著的棺材裡又裝著什麼秘密？

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: 世界聞名的賭神高進（周潤發飾）在決戰前夕，跌下山坡導致失憶，幸得小流氓陳小刀（劉德華）照顧有加期間高進堂弟殺害高進女友，並派人追殺高進高進幾經波折後，與賭王陳金城競賽並贏得賭局，亦對堂弟之背叛成功復仇

programme.title: 鐵拉瑪九壯士
programme.desc: 1942年挪威德軍佔領區，反抗軍截獲情報，經物理學家羅爾夫解密得知，納粹德國透過在鐵拉瑪的挪威化工廠生產重水有了重大突破，將可能領先盟軍製作出原子彈盟軍得知消息後派出英軍突擊隊，卻全軍覆沒，眼見大量重水及設施即將運往德國，勢單力薄的反抗軍該如何阻止納粹德國的邪惡計畫？

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻李連杰飾常教人練武可自強救國，但見政府苟且，洋人橫行，民間私鬥，漸覺武術不可解國困沙河市黑幫到戲班收取保護費，衍生連串風波戲班開鑼日，鴻被人追殺，死傷無數提督大怒，要查封寶芝林及逮捕鴻，鴻答允救治傷者後投案沙河幫並將十三姨關之琳飾擄走，鴻與寬合力救出十三姨，寬亦拜鴻為師，從此隨鴻學藝

programme.title: 教父
programme.desc: 二戰後的紐約黑手黨柯里昂家族，是以賭博走私和操控工會的黑幫企業，首領維多嚴守傳統黑幫道德準則，拒絕販售敗壞人心的毒品被人尊為教父而其他黑手黨家族為謀求更高利益的毒品生意，希望在警政界具影響力的維多加入經營被拒後，一場腥風血雨的黑幫血拚暗殺，正襲向維多的柯里昂家族

programme.title: 西部殺陣
programme.desc: 前軍人勒邁過去的任務曾撲殺夏安族人，也因此被夏安族首領詛咒，預言他將被自己的孩子殺死勒邁深怕預言成真，開始尋找失散的孩子們，為避免被他們殺死，勒邁先將他們一一殺害，直到剩下最後一個兒子卡爾卡爾本身也是一個不法之徒，受到賞金獵人和警察的追捕勒邁必須設法阻止他的兒子，並終結這場詛咒

programme.title: 戴高樂傳奇
programme.desc: 戴高樂是法國著名的軍事家政治家，在二次大戰期間領導自由法國運動，戴高樂改變了二戰結局及法國的歷史1940年5月，法國被德軍攻克新上任的夏爾戴高樂將軍加入巴黎政府，而他的妻子伊馮娜及三個孩子則留在東部就在新上任總理貝當打算向希特勒投降並與之談判時，戴高樂只有一個目的：繼續抵抗德軍伊馮娜和孩子們被迫與數千個法國家庭一起逃離德軍的入侵在彼此毫無音訊的情況下，戴高樂一家是否會淪為法國的犧牲品？

programme.title: 孤雛淚
programme.desc: 英國維多利亞時期，身世不明的孤兒奧利佛困苦度日某日奧利佛只為多求得一碗粥而被認為不服管教轉賣給殯儀館當學徒，依舊擺脫不了受虐的命運，於是逃亡到倫敦，輾轉進入扒竊集團並被誤認為竊嫌，幸得目擊者於法庭上證明無辜富有的竊案失主布朗洛先生為補償奧利佛而將他帶回收留，殊不知他正是失蹤多年姪女的遺腹子

programme.title: 歲月風雲之上海皇帝
programme.desc: 陸月生本是小販出身，因用流氓手法偵破宋教仁被刺案而聲名大噪，受到法租界總探長黃全榮賞識，從此平步青雲，依附軍閥勢力，逐步攀升成為上海大亨但好景不長，1927年，上海迎來前所未有的社會動盪與政治鉅變，軍閥割據，民不聊生，國共反目，工人造反，陸月生最終被國民黨利用，參與了反對鎮壓工人武裝的鬥爭與屠殺共產黨人的陰謀

programme.title: 上海皇帝之雄霸天下
programme.desc: 1930年代，陸月生黃全榮及袁嘯軍合稱上海三大亨此時的上海一步步成為國共兩黨內部的戰場，加上日軍野心勃勃，社會瀰漫著軍變前的恐慌陸月生感到前途茫茫，希望藉國民黨的力量在政治上找尋出頭機會然而在狡詐的政治舞台，其背景反成為被攻擊的把柄，一代梟雄失意後一病不起含恨而終

programme.title: 羅馬假期
programme.desc: 年輕的安妮公主在歐洲各國進行親善訪問被皇室生活的繁文縟節壓得喘不過氣的她，趁著在羅馬訪問的夜晚，偷溜出大使館，想要體驗嚮往的平凡生活，而意外邂逅了美國記者喬隔天喬認出了她就是據說生病無法公開露面的安妮公主，為了獨家新聞，他不動聲色帶著自稱為安雅的公主到羅馬各大景點遊玩，並暗地裡聯絡狗仔攝影師前來偷拍雖然只有短短一天兩人卻從陌生到熟悉漸漸擦出愛的火花

programme.title: 守龍者
programme.desc: 自古相傳，應龍族保護風調雨順，而守龍者和他們命運相連，現世僅剩被囚禁的兩條龍與最後一個守龍者萍，為了拯救倉鼠夥伴，萍深入洞穴，與丹紫露雨的相遇意外解開她的真實身份守龍者能量覺醒，萍也收到嚴峻的任務：將最後一顆龍蛋送往育龍潭孵化，一人一龍的冒險成長之旅就此開啟

programme.title: 虎豹小霸王
programme.desc: 懷俄明州名號響亮的搶盜集團山洞幫以火車為搶劫目標，鐵路公司不堪損失，招募一批專業高手追捕隊設局擒拿，目標是靈魂人物布屈和日舞小子事發之後兩人無論使出什麼招數皆無法躲過追緝，最後決定與精通西班牙語的日舞女友艾塔三人，一起逃往南美洲的玻利維亞展開亡命生活，突然陰魂不散的追捕隊現身當地

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: 呂良偉飾演六年代香港黑道傳奇人物跛豪，他過去因曾遭到伏擊受傷變成跛子，號跛豪心有不甘的跛豪，設計陷害對頭肥波（鄭則仕飾），安排他藏有毒品入獄，再緊抓住探長的弱點，用黑錢賄賂他，使出一連串的計謀，剷除異己，整飭黑道，但終因得罪的人太多，事跡敗露，為人黑吃黑，即使探長想幫他，也礙莫能助

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不插電露營新
programme.desc: 不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從心出發的旅程山林間的挑戰露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的行動電源，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 賽車手失意澳門邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣四人在工作夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 朴敘俊回歸攜手魷魚2元志安 等待京道譜十年宿命戀十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 歐若拉公主完

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.desc: 朴敘俊回歸攜手魷魚2元志安 等待京道譜十年宿命戀十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 賽車手失意澳門邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣四人在工作夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向

programme.title: 歐若拉公主完
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

法國西岸滋味遊英
programme.desc: 與名廚紀爾恩巴林希米一同探索諾曼第，從令人嘆為觀止的石灰岩懸崖到充滿魅力的多維爾，沿途享受優美風景和美食，品嘗忌廉醬牛仔肉，參觀樸實的芝士牧場和卡爾瓦多斯酒的釀酒廠，沉浸於諾曼第的豐富文化和風味中

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊英
programme.desc: 今集來到有天空之地之稱的薩斯喀徹溫省；大地很平坦，日出和日落也像永無止境米高和韋爾品嘗芥末氈酒，自製正宗帕尼尼三文治，深入薩斯喀徹溫騎士的陣地，及到原住民旅舍體驗生態旅遊，踏胖胎單車和划艇

programme.title: 邵逸夫獎2026英
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫生命科學與醫學獎，平均頒予安妮德尚戴宇閣及陳竺，以表彰他們發現急性早幼粒細胞白血病在分子與細胞層面的致病基礎，並開創了協同標靶治療方案，令這種疾病從最致命的癌症行列，轉變為治癒率最高的癌症之一，治癒率超過九成

programme.title: 穹蒼下的城堡英
programme.desc: 意大利有壯麗的自然景色和歷史被大海和高山分割的地貌，形成的多樣化自然生態，反映在不同的建築物之上，每一座都有重大的文化價值無論是建於高聳山岬上的堅固要塞，抑或幾乎沉入水裏的神話城堡，都值得觀賞

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 嘉賓佐舒里林設計的神秘盒內，放滿魴魚的各個部位他要求參賽者開放思想，創作出超越傳統搭配的菜式，並親自示範如何分解魴魚有些參賽者未能充分展示魴魚的美味，無法達到要求，而表現最差的三名將接受壓力考驗

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 愛迪費奧和姬絲要面對由阮盧克設計的壓力考驗，他們要利用牛鞭這種古怪食材，複製出阮從小就烹調的牛肉河粉，而更出乎意料的是，他們沒有食譜可循愛迪最初自信滿滿，但費奧和姬絲則滿心不安最後誰將會出局？

programme.title: 狗狗老友記英
programme.desc: 在得州，一隻名叫王子的草原犬鼠在與牠最好的朋友名叫班克斯的德國牧羊犬玩耍和摔跤時表現得很好一隻被寵壞的獲救小松鼠，名叫沙克，牠從一隻名叫梅杰的年輕金毛尋回犬那裡得到了牠所需要的全部關注和愛

programme.title: 節拍小天地英

programme.title: 台慶鉅獻:野性王國英
programme.desc: 花豹媽媽奧林巴迫女兒穆蒂瑪迅速成長獅群的統治地位日益鞏固，為鬣狗族群及其幼崽帶來毀滅性後果當風暴產下第二窩幼崽時，鬣狗窩遭遇災難，隨著獅群步步逼近，鬣狗在這個王國中的地位岌岌可危

programme.title: 優遊假期英

programme.title: 殭屍家族粵

Disco at the BBC: Volume 3
programme.desc: A selection of dance floor disco classics from the 1970s and 1980s, with performances from the BBCs music archives. Featuring, Tina Charles, The Real Thing, Sister Sledge and The Bee Gees

programme.title: Studio 54
programme.desc: New York Citys Studio 54 was the epicentre of 1970s hedonism, a place that not only redefined the nightclub, but also came to symbolize an entire era. In this documentary, Ian Schrager, one of the two people behind Studio 54s creation, tells the in-depth story of how one of the worlds greatest nightclubs was created

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution
programme.desc: A look at how disco fell victim to a violent backlash at the end of the 1970s after a glut of bad singles and the perceived elitism of clubs like Studio 54 fuelled a surge in anti-disco feeling. The programme also traces the genres legacy, with DJ Frankie Knuckles leaving New York for Chicago, where he remixed disco breaks with RB to produce a new genre of dance music that became known as house

programme.title: Sounds of the 70s

programme.title: 玫瑰的故事The Tale of Rose
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着

programme.title: 不眠日Mobius
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静因为他知晓这并非最终结局而是循环日，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控时间密钥的人当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. programme.title: Africas Hidden Kingdoms Season 1
programme.desc: For most of the year its a desert, but during early August and September the dusty valleys of Namaqualand transform into a wonderland carpeted with wildflowers. Witness this magnificent transformation from arid desert to beautiful oasis.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere.The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales play with penguins and sea lions and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia Season 1
programme.desc: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: 野火短劇Wildfire Mini drama
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力

programme.title: 食遇人間Food Encounters

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.desc: 剧集讲述外科医生，爱上因事故而陷入脑昏迷的知名女星，为拯救她而进行了禁忌的脑部置换手术，之后的故事交织着爱情与欲望禁忌与牺牲Genius neurosurgeon Shin Ju-shin is head over heels in love with top actress Momo. When Momo falls into a coma following a tragic accident, Ju-shin faces the prospect of losing her. Momo eventually wakes up, but she is inhabited by a different consciousness, triggering tragic and unforeseen consequences.

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2Listen! Taiwan Sings 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事Hosted by Wonfus frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwans people and heritage.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 风味转身Flavor Tailor
programme.desc: 节目走访台湾十三种经历复育传承或亟待被看见的农渔物产，深入产地跟随农渔民走进真实日常，从凌晨采收到彻夜制作，在台风暴雨与严苛环境中，以最贴近土地的视角，记录他们守护风土延续技艺的坚持与韧性Across Taiwan, this series explores 13 revived, preserved, or overlooked agricultural and fishery treasures, following farmers and fishers through long days, wild weather, and hard-earned traditions rooted in the land.

programme.desc: 无忧渡讲述了一个有着神秘背景的猎魔人宣夜和一个聪明可爱的女孩半夏，一起保护自己家园的奇幻故事自从半夏与宣夜认识之后，两人在人妖共存的世界共历奇情悬案，共同调查着一件件诡异的案件，两个人的感情也越来越好，可是因为宣夜身上的秘密，两个人却一次又一次的远离，最终发现半夏是揭开他身上秘密的钥匙

programme.title: 夜色正浓The Glamorous Night
programme.desc: 该剧根据右耳的原著小说Sales夫妇改编，讲述了一群在洋酒行业相关工作的年轻人，行业白领们，为了业绩与生活努力奋斗拼搏，一路上被人性与现实考验，最终从底层的促销员成为行业风云人物的成长故事Adapted from You Ers novel Sales Couple, the series tells the story of a group of young professionals working in the imported liquor industry as white-collar workers strive to succeed in both their careers and personal lives.

programme.title: 轧戏Love Between Lines
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘漫雪纷飞谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. Their unexpected real-world reunion unveils hidden identities, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. As they navigate a dislocated space-time, they grow together, transforming through love and self-discovery.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 2
programme.desc: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

programme.title: Africas Hidden Kingdoms Season 1
programme.desc: This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africas wilderness.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli Season 1
programme.desc: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo Johnny Kant and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumbas first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 3
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who arent all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳Travel With The Royal Family
programme.desc: 蔡少芬陶昕然斕曦張曉龍藍盈瑩陳思斯楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成煥新團，從承載無數記憶的甄嬛傳拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成煥新之旅

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季Singing With Legends Season 5 Repackaged

Sementara itu, Nita mengugut mahu membongkar skandal mereka jika Ryan enggan bertanggungjawab, dan Eunos pula dipukul orang suruhan Joe.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn Abdullah menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Outbreak
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, Aina Suzaily sebagai hos bersama Nizam Lee Skateboarder akan mendekati aktiviti sukan Skateboard dan meliputi segala aspek dari segi sejarah, keselamatan dan kemahiran.

programme.title: Kembara
programme.desc: Kembara kali ini membawa Azizul Ammar ke daerah Pedas, Negeri Sembilan untuk meneroka keunikan Masha The Bear . Bukan sekadar nama yang mencuri tumpuan, lokasi ini menawarkan cabaran pendakian yang menguji stamina serta aktiviti memancing yang menenangkan di tasik yang menghijau

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Akhirnya selesai majlis pernikahan wok di pejabat agama. Sekejap sahaja segalanya berubah. Wok dibawa pulang ke rumah deris dan janji deris akan selalu membawa wok pulang. setelah seminggu bernikah, belum lagi batang hidung mereka kelihatan. Disangkakan malam pertama penuh bahagia, tersiksa dibalik pintu yang begitu asing bagi diri wok.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan
programme.desc: Aisya diuji lagi apabila Hakim meninggal dunia secara tiba-tiba. Kehilangan ini memberi tamparan hebat dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan
programme.desc: Dengan semangat yang masih bersisa, Aisya berusaha untuk terus kuat demi anaknya dan kerjayanya. Dia mula menulis lagu-lagu yang mencerminkan perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan
programme.desc: Lagu-lagu Aisya mendapat perhatian ramai, dan dia kembali dikenali dalam industri muzik. Namun, dia tetap merendah diri dan tidak lupa asal usulnya.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan
programme.desc: Fareez muncul kembali dalam hidup Aisya, menyesali perbuatannya. Aisya memaafkannya, namun memilih untuk tidak kembali bersama demi kebaikan bersama.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan
programme.desc: Aisya berdiri teguh sebagai seorang wanita yang tabah, ibu yang penyayang, dan penyanyi yang berjaya. Dia membuktikan bahawa setiap wanita mampu bangkit walau diuji seberat mana sekalipun.

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Andy Teh, Syafiq, Hans Yusoff dan Yonnyboii.

programme.title: Misteri Mona Ku Serumu Kembali
programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok disiksa suami sendiri, disiksa batin dan fizikal kerana nafsu binatangnya. Maimun semakin teruk dan akhirnya menghembuskan nafas seorang diri di rumah. Sampai ke bandar, usop sedaya upaya menjejaki Wok. Akhirnya usop dapat bertemu dengan Deris. Wok dapat melepaskan diri, apabila Deris telah lalai kelam kabut keluar rumah tanpa mengunci mangga pintu.

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.desc: Rina hidup dalam kesunyian selepas kehilangan ibunya dan membesar dengan luka yang tidak pernah sembuh. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Bonnie
programme.desc: Bonnie, seorang remaja sekolah menengah, mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam. Walau bagaimanapun, berbekalkan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri, dia mampu bertahan untuk melindungi dirinya malah orang-orangnya.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP5

programme.title: The Hidden Hand Dia Perempuan Sialan EP4
programme.desc: Nerina mengalami halusinasi yang menakutkan serta kesakitan fizikal, menyebabkan Syawal berasa buntu dan terdesak. Selepas Riska berpura-pura menyelamatkan Nerina daripada satu serangan, Ustaz Halim mengedarkan limau sebagai pelindung.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP4
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah pusat sukan ekstrim di Kg. Lagong, Batu Caves, Selangor. Pengantara menemu bual pemilik pusat tersebut Encik Affandi dan Encik John Bear seorang pengunjung. Mereka bberkongsi pelbagai pengalaman misteri semasa berada di pusat riadah berkenaan. Pengantara bersama John Bear berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi gangguan lembaga misteri dan bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. John Bear juga berkongsi pengalaman yang baru dilaluinya.

programme.title: 3 Cewek Petualang
programme.desc: Sally, Lyla, Citra, Jubed dan Randu lima sahabat dari zaman sekolah menengah merancang satu pertemuan semula. Sally mengajak rakan-rakannya melawat sebuah pulau berhampiran Belitong.

programme.title: Siccin 7
programme.desc: Terpaksa meninggalkan kerjayanya sebagai doktor dan melarikan diri akibat satu perjanjian berdarah dengan sindiket mafia yang mengeksploitasi kanak-kanak pengemis, Kemal berpindah bersama keluarganya ke rumah agam milik bapa saudaranya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: Led by experienced journalists, this current-affairs documentary travels beyond borders to investigate major international stories and social issues. Each report combines on-location observation, interviews and human perspectives to explain how global events affect ordinary lives.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu has been waiting for her first love for 10 years but he marries someone else in the end. As she loses faith in love, she meets a wedding planner and a handsome and rich man, who both help her get over her ex-boyfriend. As Chu Chu feels the same love from them, she must make up her mind. Who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Z Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk is on the case of a corrupt policeman but finds all key witnesses killed when he starts to discover some clues. As investigation continues, Luk uncovers the fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the governments 15 billion Care Fund. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem...

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhens childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shihs magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lins sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces!

programme.title: Nesam
programme.desc: Nathans loan rejection from a bank leads him to pursue a romantic relationship with the daughter of the bank manager, but his intentions are discovered, resulting in unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Krack
programme.desc: When 3 notorious criminals lock horns with a hot-tempered police officer, Potharaju Shankar, little do they know that they will end up behind bars.

programme.title: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
programme.desc: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

programme.title: Deiva Machan
programme.desc: Karthi is guided by visions of a man on a white horse as he strives to arrange his sisters marriage. However, an ominous prophecy soon unfolds, bringing unexpected troubles his way.

programme.title: Mirugaa
programme.desc: Forest officials in Kotagiri hunt a man-eating tiger that is attacking innocent people. At the same time, a serial killer is on the prowl for wealthy single women.

programme.title: Thamizharasan
programme.desc: A disgruntled police officer takes control of a hospital after the hospital staff neglect his ailing son. Eventually, conflict arises after he refuses to follow a direct order from his senior.

programme.title: Meymarandhen Paaraayo
programme.desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Vijay, replaces him just before his brother is set to be crowned as the king. Princess Maithili falls in love with Prem.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Bhola Shankar
programme.desc: In Kolkata, a taxi driver fights to build a new life with his sister, but his dark past catches up with him as he battles the citys dangerous underworld.

programme.title: Idhu Kathirvelan Kadhal
programme.desc: Kathir, who hates marriage, is in Coimbatore to resolve a family dispute. There, he falls for Pavithra but his heart is broken when he discovers that she is in love with someone else.

programme.title: Maaman Magal
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation about her husband, a woman seeks a divorce, but then discovers she is pregnant, leading to a difficult decision.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Desingu Raja
programme.desc: Idhyakani falls for Bindu Madhavi despite their families rivalry. The lovers try to unite them, but their efforts lead to a conflict between the families.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Wild Birds Of Australia
programme.desc: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: Wild Birds Of Australia
programme.desc: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

programme.title: Wild Birds Of Australia

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong

programme.title: 人生調色盤第297集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 魯蛇玩很大
programme.desc: 魯蛇玩很大來賓以年輕創業者為主，也涵蓋少數中壯年齡層，他們以過來人的角度，回溯過去創業初期失敗的經歷，回首來時路，發現不同時代的做夢者，其實都需要同樣的勇氣和意志這些人都曾面臨失敗低潮，但最終挺過黑夜，迎來陽光他們將在節目中分享一路走來的心路歷程，讓觀眾除了看見成功者光鮮亮麗的表象，也看見新創背後，所需要的苦功與深層思考在節目中，有許多精心安排的巧思：快問快答讓觀眾在短時間內快速認識各集來賓給年輕自己的一封信以過來人的身分，給予當時的自己與現在的年輕人最真切的忠告與期勉，最後對十年後自己的期許請來賓分享未來展望萬事起步難，聆聽他們分享創業初期的甘苦談，創業時面臨

programme.desc: 另一種注目是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索台灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄

programme.title: 網紅與善的距離
programme.desc: 節目海選60位網紅深入社福機構，挑戰在90秒短影音中呈現善的理念，以流量行善，展現網紅在面對社會議題時的真實影響力

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 與匠同行

programme.title: 行動現場第566集
programme.desc: 愛，不漏接，做，就對了！ 臺灣社會貧富懸殊強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規人力經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落 我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接需要幫助的人

programme.title: 愛重生第5集

programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第163集
programme.desc: 什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間在手術室在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？ 志為人醫守護愛帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親 以病為師的堅持病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第198集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題 解讀近代事件中，慈濟曾經參與的足跡，至今正在持續的行動，以及留給未來的影響力為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展推動拔苦予樂的希望工程

programme.title: 行動現場第566集
programme.desc: 愛，不漏接，做，就對了！ 臺灣社會貧富懸殊強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規人力經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落 我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接需要幫助的人

programme.title: 人文講堂第610集
programme.desc: 人文講堂節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點

programme.title: 我們的島
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續1998年11月1日我們的島節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，我們的島為環境發出另一種聲音，至今我們的島仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以環境為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年我們的島製作

programme.title: 公視午間新聞

programme.desc: 透過荒野挑戰的設計，讓孩子在壓力未知與合作中做中學，不僅能學習山林知識與生存技能，更能培養自我認識溝通與解決問題的能力，將荒野任務轉化為真實的成長經驗

programme.title: 浩克慢遊
programme.desc: 浩克慢遊，主題設定為英雄的旅程，製作人林彥輝分享，靈感來自旅行途中，遇見的那些堅守信念的人們，希望透過本季節目學習他們的勇敢，並感謝他們的付出，旅行是一種自我療癒的過程

programme.title: 二呆流浪記之完全大人手冊
programme.desc: 二呆流浪記之完全大人手冊，找來兩位新生代備受矚目演員曾敬驊朱軒洋搭檔首度主持實境節目，希望藉由節目來探討兩人正值25歲這個由男孩轉大人的人生重要階段，如何面對成為大人這門課

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞
programme.desc: 公視晚間新聞因為新聞內容淨化幾乎看不到其他台灣新聞台的血腥火爆的場面，且素材多元，針對民生消費台灣政經社會人文環境等議題報導都極為深入

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地了解全球情勢

programme.title: 一字千金
programme.desc: 一字千金是台灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制全能制作公司制作天衍互動技術協助以漢字為主題并體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱電視史上結合App最緊張最刺激的文字書寫比賽，并曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎由曾國城擔任主持人節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，并以常用國字標準字體表次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為范疇至于答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據

programme.title: 我在工場拍拍手3
programme.desc: 第三季延續前作精神，以向每一雙沒有停下來的手拍拍手為核心，深入全台各角落，透過 30 個單元與 30 種產業，記錄不同領域的勞動身影，帶領觀眾在繁忙的日常中，看見工作背後的生命風景與深刻的職人價值

programme.title: 盲蛙牧場藏寶之謎第5季:第6集
programme.desc: 盲蛙團隊為了追尋傳說中失落的阿茲特克寶藏，再度踏上冒險旅程，然而這一次，他們必須在沒有牧場大家長的情況下進行在一本摩門教手記遺留的神秘線索引領下，喬許菲德曼與父親榮恩接手尋寶任務，深入調查一連串隱藏密室，深信其中藏有他們苦苦追尋的阿茲特克黃金

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第7集
programme.desc: 鋼是現今人類生活的重要原料，在澳洲的礦場會先鑽洞放置炸藥，再進行開採，之後壓碎礦石和分類篩選，最後經由專屬網絡運輸到全球各地洪水氾濫會造成嚴重災害，因此荷蘭有一群防洪專家想建造最堅固的防波堤，建造了世上最大的波浪機，藉此測試防坡堤是否夠穩固玻璃吊燈象徵著財富與權勢，手工雕花玻璃與金屬裝飾需花上數月時間才可完成，用浮石粉末進行打磨，再以黃銅冠當作基座

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹牡蠣刀LED燈和鑽石的製作牡蠣刀的材質是碳鋼，壓製成形後，要用熔鹽加熱處理以使鋼硬化，冷卻後將刀片磨利，再裝上握把便完成體育場的LED燈是先將68個LED燈嵌在燈板上，再將三塊燈板接合成為一組燈具，經過照明設計後，共安裝300組所構成，不只有照明功效，還能創造燈光效果，更是低耗能高效率的產品人造鑽石，是先將鑽石種子洗淨，送入模擬鑽石生成條件的機器中，灌入氫氣和甲烷，並以高溫促使碳原子釋出，一點一滴結晶在鑽石種子上，長成後，經過拋光和切割便與天然鑽石無異

programme.title: 金礦的賭注急流篇第8季:第8集
programme.desc: 抱病回歸的達斯汀迫切需要黃金來彌補他所付出的成本，因此轉往危險的瀑布作業

programme.title: 金礦的賭注急流篇第8季:第9集

programme.title: 重啟水舞傳奇

programme.title: 舊貨獵人修復篇第5季:第9集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察精挑細選古董舊貨，交給工匠團隊巧手修復，賦予全新生命他們將看似無用的舊物修復成賺錢寶物，雖然客戶挑三揀四，但潛在利潤驚人

programme.title: 河中巨怪第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 在本集節目，生物學家兼狂熱釣客傑洛米韋德前往中非的剛果河，追查一種謎樣般的河怪一如往常，他先四處打聽這種魚的傳說及故事，以掌握重要資訊他聽到一名小女孩遭猛魚攻擊的事件，並得知剛果河岸居民對有人遭攻擊，各有不同的經歷打聽過後，他確認這種河怪為黃金猛魚這不僅是一流的掠食魚，更是最凶殘的淡水河怪滿嘴利牙流線身形驚人速度都令人敬畏三分在釣魚過程中，傑洛米三度錯失釣到猛魚的機會，使他氣餒不已，並開始質疑是否真能捕捉到這種河怪剛果河岸的村民帶他找一位老巫醫，希望借助神靈的力量來幫他釣猛魚半信半疑的他在巫醫進行完儀式後，重返剛果河，準備奮力一搏屢次錯失良機的他能否得償所願？傑洛米將再度

programme.title: 河中巨怪第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 傑洛米韋德重返25年前去過的剛果，想一探水妖傳說的虛實，上一回無功而返，這次他一心要捕獲一尾巨鯰他冒著自身安危，來到世上最暴力的地方經過數世紀的殖民剝削和種族衝突，剛果名列世上最貧窮和最危險的國家，人民缺乏物資，生活嚴峻，靠著捕魚勉強維生他乘船往剛果河上游的朋加村出發，回想起當年在此罹患瘧疾的惡夢般經歷在酋長殷圭瑪的協助下，主持人得以和當地漁夫交談，並得知更多關於巨鯰的消息他試著在河中拉線佈餌，甚至不顧蚊子的猛烈攻擊，徹夜在釣竿前看著，日復一日，無奈就是毫無展獲，好景不常，酋長的兄弟去捕魚失蹤了，迷信的村民把矛頭指向他，更糟的是，暴風將至，再再增加捕鯰魚的危險程度究竟主持人能否順利
